coachEvents.text: Coast bar — body jab, body cross, empty, empty, straight time, nine bars. Body jab, body cross, then two empty slots. Come back tall and balanced.
Jab, body cross, body lead hook, cross — time-and-a-half, thirty bars. Head jab, body cross, body lead hook, head cross. Move between floors smoothly.
Jab, body jab, cross — double-time, twenty bars. Jab, body jab, cross. Quick level change, then reset.
